correctness.rationale: Using the applicable symmetric-core uniform-tree trace-norm formula (Levene Theorem 3.8) and principal-corner Schatten-one pinching, the trial profile u0=1, uj=(3/4)(97/100)^(j-1), branching m=10000, height h=100 produces the displayed lower L/S for the Schur norm of the attached crown J12-I12. Independent rational arithmetic verified the radical lower squares, 30*97^33<11*100^33, (97/100)^198<1/400, and the exact positive lower margin 496253/189120000 in L-2S. Direct numerical evaluation agrees L/S=2.0003291861... >2. The n>=12 extension follows from including a matching 12-crown-with-attachments as an induced submatrix and monotonicity of Schur multiplier norm under compression. It proves existence of the enormous finite productive graph, not exact norm or smallest n.
